reentrancy.name: Reentrancy
reentrancy.description: An external call interrupts the current execution and calls back into the original function before state changes are committed.

access_control.name: Access Control
access_control.description: Failure to properly restrict access to privileged functions.

oracle_manipulation.name: Oracle Manipulation
oracle_manipulation.description: Manipulating price or data feeds (often via flash loans) to trick a contract into making favorable calculations.

arithmetic.name: Arithmetic
arithmetic.description: Integer overflow/underflow or precision loss issues.

dos.name: Denial of Service
dos.description: An attack that prevents users from interacting with the contract.

front_running.name: Front-running
front_running.description: Exploiting transaction ordering in the mempool.
